Alexis Saelemaekers.note: Saelemaekers gives Belgium running balance on the outside. His late goal against New Zealand showed he can still arrive after doing the less glamorous work.
Alexis Saelemaekers.noteZh: 萨勒马克尔斯给比利时边路提供跑动平衡。他对新西兰的后段进球说明，做完不显眼的工作后，他仍能到位。

Amadou Onana.note: Onana gives Belgium size in midfield when games become about second balls. Against Spain, his value is making the first contact hard enough for De Bruyne to play after it.
Amadou Onana.noteZh: 奥纳纳在比赛变成第二落点争夺时给比利时中场提供身材。对西班牙时，他的价值是把第一下对抗做硬，让德布劳内能在之后处理球。

Arthur Theate.note: Theate is left-side defensive strength for a Belgium back line that has rotated often. He helps when the match asks for contact more than clean buildup.
Arthur Theate.noteZh: 泰特是比利时轮换后防中的左侧力量点。当比赛更需要身体对抗而不是干净组织时，他能帮上忙。

Axel Witsel.note: Witsel is Belgium's emergency calm. If the match starts moving too fast, he gives them the veteran pass and position that lower the temperature.
Axel Witsel.noteZh: 维特塞尔是比利时的紧急冷静按钮。如果比赛开始过快，他用老将的传球和站位帮球队降温。

Brandon Mechele.note: Mechele has been a regular centre-back through Belgium's run. His job is not fancy: clear the first ball, organize the box, and let the creators decide the other end.
Brandon Mechele.noteZh: 梅赫勒是比利时这段征程中的常规中卫。他的任务并不花哨：处理第一点、组织禁区，再让进攻端的创造者决定比赛。

Charles De Ketelaere.note: De Ketelaere turned the United States match with two early goals and an assist. He gives Belgium height up front without making the attack feel stiff.
Charles De Ketelaere.noteZh: 德凯特拉雷用两个早段进球和一次助攻改变了对美国的比赛。他给比利时锋线提供身高，却不会让进攻变得僵硬。

Diego Moreira.note: Moreira is Belgium's left-side speed card from the bench. He matters if Spain pin Belgium back and the first outlet has to travel fast.
Diego Moreira.noteZh: 莫雷拉是比利时替补席上的左侧速度牌。如果西班牙把比利时压回去，而第一条出路必须很快，他就有价值。

Dodi Lukebakio.note: Lukebakio has become the direct wide runner in Belgium's knockout mix. Even when he misses, like the bar before the Senegal penalty, he changes the pressure.
Dodi Lukebakio.noteZh: 卢克巴基奥已经成为比利时淘汰赛组合中的直接边路跑动点。即使没有进球，比如对塞内加尔点球前击中横梁，他也会改变压力。

Hans Vanaken.note: Vanaken has given Belgium late height and timing, scoring against the United States and setting up Lukaku. He arrives when defenders are already watching the ball.
Hans Vanaken.noteZh: 瓦纳肯给比利时比赛后段带来身高和时机，对美国进球并助攻卢卡库。他会在防守者已经盯球时到达。

Jeremy Doku.note: Doku is Belgium's defender remover. He has switched sides in this run, but the job stays the same: isolate one player and make the whole block lean toward him.
Jeremy Doku.noteZh: 多库是比利时拆掉防守者的人。这段征程中他换过边，但任务不变：一对一吸住一名防守者，让整条防线向他倾斜。

Joaquin Seys.note: Seys is young full-back energy for Belgium. His path is late minutes, outside pressure, and keeping the flank from feeling tired.
Joaquin Seys.noteZh: 塞斯是比利时年轻的边后卫活力。他的路径是后段出场、边路施压，并让这一侧不显得疲劳。

Kevin De Bruyne.note: De Bruyne is still Belgium's chance architect, even with others taking the goals. When he faces forward, Lukaku and the late runners start moving before the pass is played.
Kevin De Bruyne.noteZh: 德布劳内依然是比利时机会的设计者，即使进球来自其他人。当他面向前场时，卢卡库和后插上球员会在传球前就开始跑动。

Koni De Winter.note: De Winter is mobile defensive cover if Belgium need another passer at the back. He gives them a cleaner exit without losing too much range.
Koni De Winter.noteZh: 德温特是比利时需要后场多一名出球者时的机动防守深度。他能提供更干净的出路，同时不损失太多覆盖范围。

Leandro Trossard.note: Trossard has been Belgium's quiet connector and finisher, with goals against New Zealand and key service in the comeback over Senegal. He finds the small finish before the defense resets.
Leandro Trossard.noteZh: 特罗萨德是比利时安静的连接点和终结点，对新西兰有进球，也在逆转塞内加尔时送出关键传球。他会在防线重置前找到小空间完成处理。

Matias Fernandez-Pardo.note: Fernandez-Pardo is a late wide-speed option. Belgium would use him when the match has opened and tired full-backs can be made to turn again.
Matias Fernandez-Pardo.noteZh: 费尔南德斯-帕尔多是比赛后段的边路速度选择。当比赛已经打开、疲劳边后卫还要再次转身时，比利时会用到他。

Maxim De Cuyper.note: De Cuyper has settled into Belgium's left-back role in the knockouts. He gives them service from deep and enough recovery work to survive counters.
Maxim De Cuyper.noteZh: 德库伊佩尔已经在淘汰赛中稳住比利时左后卫位置。他提供深处传球，也有足够回追来应对反击。

Mike Penders.note: Penders is young goalkeeper depth behind Courtois and Lammens. For this tournament, his role is insurance rather than a likely match story.
Mike Penders.noteZh: 彭德斯是库尔图瓦和拉门斯身后的年轻门将深度。在这届世界杯中，他更像保险，而不是马上会成为比赛主线的人。

Nathan Ngoy.note: Ngoy has started several matches as Belgium's athletic centre-back. He gives them recovery runs when the game gets stretched around De Bruyne's riskier passes.
Nathan Ngoy.noteZh: 恩戈伊已经多次作为比利时运动型中卫首发。当德布劳内更冒险的传球让比赛被拉开时，他提供回追能力。

Nicolas Raskin.note: Raskin gave Belgium a key assist for Lukaku against New Zealand. He is the midfield bite who tries to turn a loose touch into a forward pass.
Nicolas Raskin.noteZh: 拉斯金对新西兰为卢卡库送出关键助攻。他是有咬劲的中场，试图把一次松散触球变成向前传球。

Romelu Lukaku.note: Lukaku has kept Belgium alive late, scoring against New Zealand, Senegal, and the United States. His card is simple: service into the box still changes the match.
Romelu Lukaku.noteZh: 卢卡库在比赛后段不断让比利时活下来，对新西兰、塞内加尔和美国都有进球。他的卡片很简单：传进禁区的球依然会改变比赛。

Senne Lammens.note: Lammens is Belgium's big goalkeeper cover. He is there if the match asks for reach, crosses, and a calmer penalty-area presence behind Courtois.
Senne Lammens.noteZh: 拉门斯是比利时高大型门将保障。如果比赛需要覆盖范围、处理传中，以及库尔图瓦身后的冷静禁区存在感，他就有价值。

Thibaut Courtois.note: Courtois gives Belgium the freedom to survive messy stretches. Against Spain, one reaction save can matter as much as anything De Bruyne creates.
Thibaut Courtois.noteZh: 库尔图瓦让比利时有能力熬过混乱阶段。对西班牙时，一次反应扑救可能和德布劳内创造的机会一样重要。

Thomas Meunier.note: Meunier's cross reopened the Senegal comeback for Lukaku. He is the veteran wide player Belgium trust when the box needs one more high ball.
Thomas Meunier.noteZh: 默尼耶的传中为卢卡库打开了逆转塞内加尔的门。他是比利时在禁区还需要一次高球时信任的老将边路。

Timothy Castagne.note: Castagne has switched defensive jobs without changing Belgium's plan. He gives them a full-back who can survive either flank while the attack rotates ahead.
Timothy Castagne.noteZh: 卡斯塔涅在比利时防线中换过职责，却不改变球队计划。他让球队拥有能应付两侧的边后卫，身前进攻也能轮换。

Youri Tielemans.note: Tielemans owns Belgium's wildest moment so far, the equalizer and 120+5 penalty against Senegal. His value is the calm shot when the match is anything but calm.
Youri Tielemans.noteZh: 蒂勒曼斯拥有比利时目前最疯狂的时刻，对塞内加尔扳平并在120+5分钟罚进点球。他的价值是在比赛完全不冷静时，仍能冷静射门。

Zeno Debast.note: Debast is Belgium's passing centre-back option. If Spain force long defensive spells, he can help the first pass come out cleaner.
Zeno Debast.noteZh: 德巴斯特是比利时的传球型中卫选择。如果西班牙迫使比利时长时间防守，他能让第一脚出球更干净。
